method: Whole-file manual reading of RecoveryShared.h/cpp,511 lines; pinned bytes verified. No disk access or recovery execution.
findings: Recovery opens source volume read-only with read/write/delete sharing and unbuffered I/O. This does not freeze live source contents. Filesystem-specific readers are selected from volume metadata for NTFS/exFAT/FAT/FAT32 only.

ReadVolume validates power-of-two alignment <=64KiB, signed seek limit, requested range and rounded sector range, grows aligned buffer, checks full returned byte count before copying. Buffer and synchronous file position are shared instance state; concurrent calls are not synchronized here.

Read<T> and Slice check subtractive bounds before copying/subspan. ReadName multiplies length by wchar_t size before Slice; caller bounds are still required to exclude arithmetic overflow. Windows UTF16 width differs from this host wchar_t.

Destination is resolved through an opened directory handle to volume GUID or UNC canonical path and verified directory attribute. It returns a string and closes handle, so later path use is not a held-handle namespace guarantee. Same-volume policy belongs to downstream recovery reader/UI.

Recycle metadata supports fixed/count-prefixed layouts, requires size/terminator and absolute filename checks, rejects malformed surrogate/control sequences. Companion collisions with conflicting metadata disable that match; cancellation errors propagate.

SafeName caps255UTF16 units, handles reserved device stems, replaces invalid code units/characters, preserves complete surrogate pairs and removes trailing spaces/dots. This is filename sanitization, not content identity verification.

OutputFile uses CREATE_NEW temporary name based on record identifiers with no sharing, checks free-space estimate and full writes, then checks source callback before and after timestamps/flush. Final handle rename does not replace existing destination.

Uncommitted output requests deletion in destructor but ignores deletion result. Predictable partial-name collisions can fail safely at CREATE_NEW; automatic retry/unique-name generation absent. Flush then rename is not proof of crash-durable directory publication.
Progress polls paused state every25ms and raises cancellation; no timeout for blocked disk I/O is established by these checks. Scan result contract retains validated partial records on cancellation.
limits: No raw-volume reads, recovered writes, device actions, Windows parser runtime, cancellation/fault injection, crash-durability or source-mutation tests performed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
